items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: Shaw always paid off. Shaw paid off $4,000... Shaw had a lot of good odds in those days. They flew the guy in here and brought me a check... Shaw wanted him.

ctx.x: So you had booked him a number of dates and then he didn't honor him? He didn't honor him. He didn't pay the date. You lost that after that. Remember the figure was $4,600.
We got $4,000 out of it. Shaw always paid off. Shaw paid off $4,000.
Because he signed with Shaw after he signed with Shaw before my contract was even up.
